insurance_intermediary_role.label: Insurance intermediary role
insurance_intermediary_role.value: Independent insurance agency distribution platform; agents shop and place policies across many carriers for customers

insurance_placement_niche.label: Insurance placement niche
insurance_placement_niche.value: Personal lines (auto, home, umbrella, life) plus small business and commercial insurance

intermediary_compensation.label: Intermediary compensation
intermediary_compensation.value: Carrier-paid commissions on policies placed, including contingent commissions, shared with affiliated agencies

carrier_market_access.label: Carrier / market access
carrier_market_access.value: Partnerships with hundreds of insurance carriers, giving customers a choice of carriers and coverage

notes: Compensation and retention are not in the evidence; compensation is from general knowledge of TWFG's model.
